# whiteboardy

> A Wails desktop app for timeboxed system design and coding interview practice. It generates an exercise with a hidden rubric, coaches while you work, and scores the result against that rubric with per-criterion evidence.

Go backend, React/TypeScript frontend, communicating over an AG-UI shaped event stream on the Wails event bus. Two modes: system design on a node-and-edge board, and coding in an editor. Model access goes through the saige agent SDK, defaulting to a local Ollama daemon, with OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google available with an API key. Sessions and settings persist as plain JSON under `~/.whiteboardy`, and rubric criteria map onto a fixed skill taxonomy so scores compare across sessions. Beta: prompts, scoring calibration, and the saved-session format are still moving.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): What it is, install, quick start, providers, known gaps
- [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md): Event stream, package map, why generation and coaching are each two LLM calls, what is computed rather than asked for

## Key Files

- Entry point: main.go (Wails options, `//go:embed all:frontend/dist`), app.go (the bound App surface)
- Domain: internal/domain/domain.go, internal/domain/taxonomy.go (fixed skill areas), internal/domain/render.go (snapshot to prompt text)
- Harness: internal/harness/problem.go (two-call generation), internal/harness/coach.go (decide then stream), internal/harness/review.go (scores computed in Go)
- Session: internal/session/runtime.go (clock, curveball timeline, coach loop, review transition)
- Events: internal/agui/agui.go (AG-UI vocabulary, single Wails channel)
- Storage: internal/store/store.go (settings, sessions, profile aggregation)
- Providers: internal/llm/llm.go (saige adapters, structured generation), internal/llm/discover.go (Ollama model listing)
- Frontend: frontend/src/agui.ts (pure event reducer), frontend/src/App.tsx, Setup.tsx, Session.tsx, Whiteboard.tsx, Review.tsx, Progress.tsx

## Optional

- [Wails](https://wails.io): Desktop framework and binding generator
- [saige](https://github.com/urmzd/saige): Agent SDK providing the provider adapters and structured generation
- [AG-UI](https://github.com/ag-ui-protocol/ag-ui): Event model the backend to frontend stream follows
- [sr](https://github.com/urmzd/sr): Release automation driven by conventional commits
